articles.title: Kanwar Yatri Injured After Mahindra Pickup Hits Him in UP's Muzaffarnagar, Driver Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Kanwar Yatri was injured after allegedly being hit by a Mahindra pickup truck in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district. The driver reportedly fled the scene without stopping after the collision.

body.html:
A Kanwar Yatri was injured after allegedly being hit by a Mahindra pickup truck in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district. The driver reportedly fled the scene without stopping after the collision.

A video of the incident, which has surfaced on social media, purportedly shows the pickup truck striking the devotee before speeding away from the spot.

The injured Kanwar Yatri was reportedly provided assistance, while the viral video has prompted police to take cognisance of the incident.

Senior police officials have directed the local police to conduct a thorough investigation, identify the vehicle and driver involved, and take appropriate legal action against those responsible.

Further details regarding the condition of the injured devotee and the identity of the accused driver are awaited.

#Muzaffarnagar #KanwarYatra #UttarPradesh

articles.title: APSRTC Driver Removed From Duty After Video Shows Him Using Mobile Phone While Driving
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An APSRTC bus driver was removed from duty after a passenger recorded a video allegedly showing him using a mobile phone while driving a bus on the Palamaneru–Madanapalle route in Andhra Pradesh's Annamayya district. The driver has been identified as K. Ganesh Kumar (badge no.

body.html:
An APSRTC bus driver was removed from duty after a passenger recorded a video allegedly showing him using a mobile phone while driving a bus on the Palamaneru–Madanapalle route in Andhra Pradesh's Annamayya district.

The driver has been identified as K. Ganesh Kumar (badge no. 3534), who was operating hire service bus AP39 UY 9691 attached to the Palamaneru depot.

After the video was sent to the authorities, State Transport, Youth and Sports Minister Mandipalli Ramprasad Reddy took serious note of the incident and directed APSRTC officials to take immediate action against the driver.

Acting on the Minister's instructions, the Palamaneru Depot Manager conducted an inquiry. The investigation reportedly confirmed that the driver was using a mobile phone while driving, following which he was removed from duty with immediate effect.

The Minister said that using a mobile phone while driving is a serious safety violation that puts passengers' lives at risk and made it clear that the government and APSRTC management will not tolerate such negligence.

He also warned that strict disciplinary action would be taken against any staff member whose actions compromise passenger safety and urged the public to immediately report such incidents to the authorities to help ensure safer public transport.

#AndhraPradesh #APSRTC #RoadSafety #PassengerSafety

articles.title: Road Rage Turns Violent: KSRTC Bus Stopped, Conductor Assaulted in Vijayapura; Passenger Also
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A North West Karnataka Road Transport Corporation (NWKRTC) bus conductor was allegedly assaulted after a group of men stopped a moving bus near Kalahalli village in Vijayapura district, triggering panic among passengers. The injured conductor has been identified as Mallu Lamani.

body.html:
A North West Karnataka Road Transport Corporation (NWKRTC) bus conductor was allegedly assaulted after a group of men stopped a moving bus near Kalahalli village in Vijayapura district, triggering panic among passengers.

The injured conductor has been identified as Mallu Lamani. According to police, the incident is believed to have stemmed from a road-rage dispute that took place a day earlier near Madari village, where an argument allegedly broke out between Lamani and auto-rickshaw driver Santosh Devura over an auto parked across the road and the right of way. Locals had intervened and pacified both sides at the time.

Police said that the following day, Santosh Devura and his associates allegedly intercepted the KSRTC bus near Kalahalli village, forcibly entered the vehicle, abused the conductor, and punched him in the chest. The conductor reportedly collapsed inside the bus due to the assault.

A passenger who tried to record the incident on a mobile phone was also allegedly attacked after the accused noticed the recording.

The attack on the public transport employee caused panic among passengers and drew strong criticism from local residents, who condemned the assault on transport staff while on duty.

Police have registered a case at the Alamela Police Station and launched an investigation. Residents have demanded strict legal action against those responsible and called for a thorough and impartial probe into the incident.

#Karnataka #Vijayapura #KSRTC #RoadRage #BusConductor

articles.title: UP Coaching Centre Row: Student Assaults Teacher Over Molestation Allegation, Viral Video Under Pol
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a teacher being assaulted by a student and her family over allegations of molestation has surfaced from the Sevarahi area of Uttar Pradesh's Kushinagar district. According to reports, the incident took place at an IIT-NEET coaching centre that had opened about a month ago.

body.html:
A video showing a teacher being assaulted by a student and her family over allegations of molestation has surfaced from the Sevarahi area of Uttar Pradesh's Kushinagar district.

According to reports, the incident took place at an IIT-NEET coaching centre that had opened about a month ago. The student allegedly told her family that the teacher had been making obscene gestures towards her.

After learning about the allegations, the student's family reportedly reached the coaching centre and assaulted the teacher. The viral video shows the teacher being slapped, kicked and beaten with slippers while surrounded by several people. The family also allegedly forced him to spit on his palm and lick it before making him apologise to the student and her family with folded hands.

The video also purportedly shows the student striking the teacher multiple times with a slipper.

Police said that after the video surfaced, a team visited the coaching centre, but it was found closed. According to Sevarahi Station House Officer Manoj Verma, neither the teacher nor the student's family has filed a formal complaint so far.

Police said both the accused teacher and the student along with her family are reportedly untraceable. The viral video is being examined, and further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation and any complaint received.

#Kushinagar #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #CoachingCentre

articles.title: Two Men Accused of Harassing Women Thrashed by Villagers in Nainital, Faces Blackened Before
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two men accused of harassing young women were allegedly caught and beaten by villagers in Satauli village near Bhawali in Uttarakhand's Nainital district. A video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

body.html:
Two men accused of harassing young women were allegedly caught and beaten by villagers in Satauli village near Bhawali in Uttarakhand's Nainital district. A video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

According to local residents, the two men allegedly misbehaved with and harassed young women walking through the village. After learning about the incident, villagers chased the accused and managed to apprehend two of them.

The accused were allegedly thrashed by villagers and some women at the spot. Their faces were blackened with soot, and stinging nettle grass was reportedly rubbed on their bodies. The entire incident was captured on video, which has since gone viral.

According to reports, the two detained men had come from Moradabad to work at a wellness centre in the area.

After receiving information, Bhawali police reached the spot and took both accused into custody. Police said further legal action will be taken after completing the investigation into the allegations.

The incident has sparked discussion among local residents, who have demanded strict action in cases involving the safety of women to prevent such incidents in the future.

#Nainital #Uttarakhand #WomenSafety #Harassment

articles.title: Flood Fury in Jalgaon: Man Climbs Tree to Escape Rising River After Sudden Water Surge
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was left stranded in the swollen Anjani River in Maharashtra's Jalgaon district after the water level rose suddenly due to continuous rainfall.

body.html:
A man was left stranded in the swollen Anjani River in Maharashtra's Jalgaon district after the water level rose suddenly due to continuous rainfall. The man, identified as Suresh Bhil, climbed a tall tree in the middle of the river to save his life after being caught in the strong current.

Local villagers spotted him stranded on the tree and immediately alerted the authorities. Rescue operations were launched, but efforts were hampered by the river's powerful flow caused by incessant rainfall in the region.

Authorities have urged residents not to cross overflowing rivers, streams or enter waterlogged areas, warning that water levels can rise suddenly and pose a serious threat to life.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) had earlier forecast widespread rainfall across Maharashtra and issued red, orange and yellow alerts for several districts.

Earlier this month, 13 people were killed and 10 others were injured in rain-related incidents across the state in a single day. According to the State Emergency Control Room, nearly 100 houses were damaged due to heavy rainfall, while hundreds of families affected by flood-like conditions were shifted to safer locations.

Officials said districts including Palghar, Mumbai and Pune recorded excess rainfall, while Nandurbar and Hingoli reported significant rainfall deficits. The State Emergency Operation Centre (SEOC) has also deployed location-based real-time weather warnings across the state.

#Jalgaon #Maharashtra #Flood #HeavyRain #RainAlert

articles.title: CCTV Captures Daylight Chain Snatching in Muzaffarnagar: Woman's Earrings Stolen by Bike-Borne
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman was allegedly targeted by bike-borne snatchers who stole her earrings in broad daylight in the Shanti Nagar area under the New Mandi police station limits of Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar on Thursday morning.

body.html:
A woman was allegedly targeted by bike-borne snatchers who stole her earrings in broad daylight in the Shanti Nagar area under the New Mandi police station limits of Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar on Thursday morning.

The incident, which took place at around 9.12 am, was captured on nearby CCTV cameras.

According to police, the woman was walking near her residence when two men arrived on a motorcycle. While one accused remained seated on the bike with the engine running, the other allegedly watched the woman's movements before approaching her from behind and snatching the earrings from both her ears.

The accused fled the spot immediately after the incident. The woman raised an alarm, prompting local residents to rush to her aid, but the suspects had already escaped.

The CCTV footage has surfaced on social media and is being examined by investigators. Police are also analysing footage from nearby cameras to identify the accused and trace their escape route.

Circle Officer Sunil Kumar said a case is being registered under the relevant provisions of law.

Police have formed four teams to identify and arrest the accused using CCTV footage and other technical evidence.

The incident has sparked concern among local residents, who have demanded increased police patrolling and strict action against those involved.

#Muzaffarnagar #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #CCTV
